column1: # pipelines.tsv — the stocked pipeline set and the revision each is pinned to.
# SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for revisions. This file decides; nothing else does.
# Docs and READMEs do carry a revision inside runnable example commands — an
# example you cannot copy is worse than a duplicated string. Those are copies,
# not authorities: change a pin here and grep the repo for the old string.
# bin/preflight.sh reads this file and refuses a cmd.sh whose -r disagrees, so
# the run you actually launch is checked against this table, not against a doc.
# A pipeline that is not listed here is not stocked. Adding a row is a
# procurement decision — see skills/bioinfo-analyze/references/new-pipeline.md.
# columns: pipeline <TAB> revision <TAB> schema_checked <TAB> note
#   revision        what -r must be. Always an exact tag, never dev/master/main.
#   schema_checked  date assets/schema_input.json was last read at this revision,
#                   or "no" if the columns are carried from knowledge rather than
#                   verified against the clone on this box.
#   note            anything that changes how the pin is chosen.
# Re-derive before the first run at any revision not used on this machine before:
#   nextflow info nf-core/<pipeline>
#   find "$NXF_ASSETS" -path '*nf-core/<pipeline>*' -name schema_input.json | head -1
